claim_ceiling: A table of carrier obligations plus a reference evaluator. Status is `runs` (the evaluator executes and returns measured exit codes on real repo receipts). It is NOT wired into any hook, gate chain, or CI job, and no admission decision in this repo derives from it.

source.spec: Owner dependency diagram supplied 2026-07-25 (typed entropy chart, root strata R0-R3, constraints C0-C7, capacity separations). PROPOSED dependency structure, not canon, not a physics claim.
source.central_rule_quoted: ENTROPY IS A TYPED CHART, NOT A VERTICAL LADDER. Each quantity is meaningful only once its REQUIRED CARRIER is declared.
source.owner_rule_for_absence: coordinates ABSENT when their required carrier is absent

why_this_is_not_the_fifth_shape_detector.the_one_error_class_four_times: Recorded at claimgate_plugin/results/purgatory_shape_detectors_v0.json. Four detector designs each established a RELIEVING SURFACE -- positions where a number is PRESUMED NOT TO BE A CLAIM -- and the payload fit into the surface every time: (1) path-prefix exclusion, (2) key-name denylist + container allowlist, (3) 22 exempt full paths with subtree pruning, (4) typed roles with bounded relieving slots. A NAME, a PATH, a TYPE and a BOUND are the same kind of thing.
why_this_is_not_the_fifth_shape_detector.the_structural_difference: This table has NO relieving positions. It does not enumerate where a number is allowed to be a non-claim. It enumerates QUANTITIES and what each one OWES. The surface is obligating, not relieving. There is nothing to aim a payload at, because no position in a receipt is marked safe.
why_this_is_not_the_fifth_shape_detector.what_the_attacker_gains_instead: Evasion moves from `put the number somewhere exempt` to `do not name the quantity`. That is a real change in the attacker's cost, and it is ALSO NOT CLOSURE. See residual_evasions.RE-1. A number nobody names is a number nobody can cite AS a von Neumann entropy, but it is still an unwitnessed number sitting in a committed file.
why_this_is_not_the_fifth_shape_detector.why_bounds_appear_at_all: Floors in this table are TABLE-FIXED CONSTANTS in the floors block, hash-covered with the file. They are not slots in a receipt. The s3/s6 defeat was a bounded slot in the RECEIPT holding a measured value (agreement.tol = 2.2e-15); a constant in the evaluator's own committed table is not a position a producer can write into.
why_this_is_not_the_fifth_shape_detector.the_honest_boundary: This table checks that a quantity's REQUIRED STRUCTURE is declared and self-consistent. It does NOT check that the number came from a computation. That is output-dependence / artifact-binding work (recorded as F9 in claimgate_plugin/results/purgatory_engine_witness_v0.json) and it is a DIFFERENT lane. A table that claimed both would be overclaiming in exactly the way the four prior designs did.

binding_modes._why: How the table decides that a quantity OCCURS in a receipt. Kept as two explicitly separate modes because the strength of the evidence differs, and collapsing them would smuggle name-matching in as if it were a declaration.

DECLARED.trigger: the receipt carries an explicit typed declaration binding a value position to a quantity id in this table, and a carrier_ref resolving to a carrier declaration
DECLARED.evidence_strength: the producer has stated what the number IS. The obligation is the producer's own.

SUSPECTED.trigger: no declaration, but a name_signal or structure_signal for the quantity matches
SUSPECTED.evidence_strength: WEAK. Recognition misfires in both directions. `path_entropy` may be a graph path count; `quotient_entropy` in this repo is a Shannon entropy over a quotient and NOT the extension capacity kappa.
SUSPECTED.disposition_on_failure: PARK, never BLOCK. Blocking on a name would repeat the F11 error in claimgate_plugin/results/purgatory_engine_witness_v0.json -- rejecting honest computation trains people to route around the gate, which costs more than the fail-open.

disposition_matrix._why: The per-quantity absent_disposition answers ONE cell of this matrix (declared quantity, missing carrier). The other cells are named so no case falls through to a default.

_semantics.BLOCK: DECIDED against the receipt. Exit 1 in the estate's convention. The receipt asserts something its own declared structure excludes; no auditor can add a field that makes it consistent.
_semantics.PARK: PENDING EVIDENCE. Exit 3 in the estate's convention. NOT ADMISSION. A PARKed quantity may not be cited, promoted, or counted as a result.
_semantics.PARK_MUST_NOT_ADMIT: Load-bearing. post_receipt_gate.sh set gate_admits=1 on ADMITTED_PENDING_DEPTH, so PARK admitted, which the regression runner's own ADMITTING set named `a forged receipt through wearing an audit-owed label`. Any consumer of this table must map PARK to gate_admits=0.

cells.why: the declared carrier's own predicate fails -- trace != 1, not PSD, p does not sum to 1, S_vn < 0 past the floor. Self-contradiction is decided.
the case the owner rule speaks to: a coordinate present without its carrier is MALFORMED.

carrier declared and internally consistent, but no artifact was compared to the claimed values. The estate's own conclusion: an obligation is discharged only by comparing an ARTIFACT's values to the claimed values. `A container exists` and `a procedure is named` are not discharges.
structure obligation met. Says NOTHING about whether an engine computed it -- see the_honest_boundary.
recognition by name or structure cannot carry a BLOCK.
a receipt that declares no quantities asserts no quantities. It is not clean -- it is uncitable. There is deliberately NO permissive fallback, because a fallback is where everything quietly routes.

floors._why: TABLE-FIXED numerical constants. Never read from a receipt. Changing one changes this file's digest, which is the point.
_floor_provenance: psd_eigenvalue_floor: chosen to admit the measured choi_min_eigenvalue = -4.634701660162015e-16 at system_v8/unified/results/manifold_unified_v2/receipt.json, which is float64 round-off on a genuine Choi matrix.

mutual_information_nonneg_floor: chosen to admit the measured mutual_information_bits = -2.1471713296250527e-13 at the same receipt, and to REFUSE the measured von_neumann_entropy_bits = -0.026676102030894332 at layer_computations.L09.shuffled_correlations, which is 11 orders of magnitude past round-off.
OPEN: both floors are absolute, and an absolute floor is dimension-blind. A 4096-dimensional accumulation can exceed 1e-12 honestly. Recorded as ambiguity AM-09.

ops._why: Closed vocabulary. The reference evaluator refuses a table containing any op not in this list, so the table cannot grow a new relieving mechanism without the evaluator failing closed.
ops.carrier_declared: a carrier declaration of the named class exists AND the quantity's carrier_ref resolves to it
ops.carrier_field_present: at least one named field exists ON THE RESOLVED CARRIER. Not anywhere in the document -- adjacency is not declaration.
ops.carrier_assert_true: a named boolean field on the resolved carrier is true, AND where the carrier supplies a spectrum the assertion is VERIFIED against it (psd is refused when the carrier's own minimum eigenvalue falls below psd_eigenvalue_floor). With no spectrum declared, the clause holds but is reported as a PRODUCER ASSERTION, because a boolean is a literal field the producer wrote. Defect D5.
ops.carrier_numeric_equals: a named numeric field on the resolved carrier equals a table-fixed value within a table-fixed floor
ops.value_range: the reported value lies in a table-fixed range, floor-relaxed
ops.value_is_integer: the reported value is an integer within log2_integrality_floor, optionally gated by a `when` clause on the carrier
ops.value_is_log2_of_integer: 2**value is an integer within log2_integrality_floor -- the finiteness signature of a counting capacity
ops.cross_quantity_le: value <= scale * (value of another quantity id bound to the SAME carrier_ref); vacuous when the other id is absent, and the vacuity is reported
ops.cut_declared: an explicit tensor/cut decomposition is declared with the stated number of parts, and the parts' declared dimensions multiply to the carrier dimension
ops.parameter_declared: a required formula parameter (for example alpha) is declared as a number, not inferred
ops.preregistered_contract: a named threshold resolves to a preregistered input contract fixed by hash, and is REFUSED if supplied by the receipt at verification time
ops.distribution_normalized: a named probability map is present, elementwise >= 0, and sums to 1 within probability_sum_floor
ops.two_compatible_states: two density carriers resolve, with same dimension, both PSD, both unit trace, and declared support inclusion
ops.process_declared: a generator and a stationary state are both declared, and the stationarity residual is present
ops.fibre_nonempty: the declared fibre or section set has cardinality >= 1 -- guards TYPED RELEASE: never 1/0, never arithmetic on an empty fibre
ops.carrier_class_disjoint_from: the quantity's carrier_ref is NOT the same declaration another listed quantity id resolves to, unless an explicit map between the two carriers is declared
ops.artifact_binding: a witnessing artifact resolves INSIDE the committed tree AFTER path resolution, the receipt carries its sha256, the EVALUATOR recomputes that digest and reads the artifact's value at a declared value_path, and the EVALUATOR compares it to the claimed value. A producer boolean such as values_compared:true is NOT accepted -- that is a literal field the producer wrote, the class recorded in claimgate_plugin/results/controller_literal_verdicts_v0.json. Defect found by measuring fixture c12.

separation_ops._why: A SECOND closed vocabulary, for checks that range over the whole declaration set rather than one quantity. Kept separate so a quantity predicate can never reach a cross-quantity mechanism by accident, and so the evaluator validates each vocabulary against its own implemented set.
separation_ops.all_pairs_distinct_carrier_class: over EVERY pair of declared quantities, two ids whose required carrier classes differ must not resolve to the same carrier declaration
separation_ops.distinct_carrier_refs: a named SUBJECT quantity must not resolve to the same carrier declaration as any of the named OTHERS. Directional on purpose: two quantities of the SAME carrier class sharing one carrier is legitimate and must not be flagged.
separation_ops.requires_declaration_when_equal: when two named quantities carry equal values within a table-fixed floor, a named extra declaration is REQUIRED on the subject
separation_ops.forbid_derivation: a named quantity must not declare derived_from pointing at a carrier of a named class
separation_ops.value_coincidence_report: REPORT_ONLY. Records that two named quantities carry equal values. Carries no disposition, on purpose.
separation_ops.aggregate_components_share_carrier_class: a declaration with role `aggregate` must have every component quantity requiring the SAME carrier class

quantities.formula: H0_addr = log2 |J|   (owner root form: J_n = {0,1}^n, |J_n| = 2^n, H0_addr = n)

all_of._why: for a BINARY address set |J_n| = 2^n exactly, so the capacity is the integer n. A non-integer value under a declared binary alphabet is a different quantity wearing this name.
R0 carries ADDRESS CAPACITY ONLY. No probability, no metric, no density matrix at this stratum.

quantities.absent_disposition_why: The carrier is one integer plus an alphabet token. An honest producer that computed log2|J| holds |J|. There is no reading in which withholding it is anything but sloppiness or evasion, and the fix is one field, so the receipt is decided rather than pending.
structure_signals: value equals log2 of a declared cardinality elsewhere in the same object
quantities.repo_instance: system_v8/engine_native/results/torch_graph/receipt.json data.packets.v7_ring_presentation_relation.hartley_capacity_bits = 3.584962500721156 = log2(12). Passes value_is_log2_of_integer. Would FAIL value_is_integer if the carrier declared a binary alphabet -- 12 is not a power of two. Which is correct behaviour and the reason the integrality clause is CONDITIONAL.

quantities.formula: H0_pair(F) = log2 |supp F|,  F : Omega_n -> K,  Omega_n = J_n x J_n,  H0_pair <= 2n

all_of._why: the pair index Omega_n = J x J must name its J. A pair capacity with no stated index set cannot be compared to the address capacity, which is the whole point of the separation.
H0_pair <= 2n is structural. A pair capacity exceeding twice the address capacity is not a tight bound being violated, it is a claim about a support larger than the space it indexes.
owner rule: the `jk fuzz` is a finite pair-supported fibre -- NOT a diagonal probability distribution, NOT a density matrix.

quantities.absent_disposition_why: Same shape as H0_addr: the carrier reduces to one integer (|supp F|) plus a reference to the index set. Cheap to supply, and without the index set reference the capacity separation cannot be evaluated at all, so the number defeats the table's central check by omission.
structure_signals: value equals log2 of a declared support_cardinality in the same object
quantities.repo_instance: No DECLARED instance found in system_v8. This quantity is currently a spec-side row, not a measured one.

quantities.formula: kappa(c) = log2 |R_c|,  R_c subset J_n x J_n,  E = coprod_{c in K} {c} x R_c

all_of._why: pi : E -> K must be declared. A per-cell capacity with no projection to the complex is not fibred over anything.
R_c subset J x J, so kappa(c) <= H0_pair over the full pair field. Equality holds exactly when the cell retains the full pair field.

quantities.absent_disposition_why: |R_c| is a finite count by construction and the cell id is a label the producer already iterated over. A per-cell capacity that cannot say WHICH cell is not a coordinate of the R3 structure, it is a loose logarithm.
structure_signals: a numeric value keyed under a cell identifier inside a declared complex
quantities.repo_instance: system_v8/nested_manifold/results/rungE/receipt.json generator.kappa = 1.0 is a GKSL dissipation rate, not an extension capacity. Under this table it does not bind to kappa_cell or kappa_ext at all -- which is the intended behaviour, and an example of why name_signals alone must never BLOCK.
quantities.table_addition: Not a row in the 9-row chart table. Taken from the diagram body at R3. Named separately from kappa_ext because the carriers differ.

quantities.formula: kappa_Pi(u) = log2 |Fib_Pi(u)|,  Fib_Pi(u) = q_Pi^{-1}(u),  q_Pi : E_C ->> Q_Pi

all_of._why: x ~_Pi y iff p(x) = p(y) for all p in Pi. Without Pi there is no equivalence and so no fibre. This is the harness rule that every claim cites a probe family, made checkable.
q_Pi is defined on E_C, the CONSTRAINT-SURVIVING part of E. A quotient taken before C0 is a different map.
TYPED RELEASE: Release_{q_Pi}(u) = Fib_Pi(u), the finite fibre DESCRIPTOR. Never 1/0. Never arithmetic on an empty fibre. A reported kappa on an empty fibre is malformed, not infinite.

quantities.absent_disposition_why: An extension capacity without its probe family names no equivalence class, so the number refers to nothing. This is the one obligation in the table that is identical to the repo's own root axiom -- identity is probe-relative -- and softening it to PARK would make the table weaker than the harness preamble it is meant to encode.
structure_signals: value equals log2 of a declared fibre_cardinality in the same object
quantities.repo_instance: system_v8/unified/results/manifold_unified_v2/receipt.json tick_chain[].L00_packet.quotient_entropy = 1.6004719623017798. 2**1.6004719623017798 = 3.033, NOT an integer, so this FAILS value_is_log2_of_integer. It is a Shannon entropy over a quotient, not an extension capacity. Binding it to kappa_ext on the strength of the word `quotient` would be a conflation the table exists to catch.

quantities.formula: Z(b) = |Gamma_b(X)|,  Gamma(X) = {(x_A) : C_AB(x_A) = x_B},  C_AB : X_A -> X_B

all_of._why: Z is indexed by b. An obstruction count with no stated boundary condition is not comparable to any other Z.
Z is a CARDINALITY, not a logarithm. A fractional Z is a different object.

quantities.absent_disposition_why: Z(b) = 0 means NO compatible whole state exists. That is the strongest exclusion statement in the C-layer and the one most worth forging, and it is meaningless without the diagram it is an obstruction FOR. The count is an integer over a declared finite set, so the carrier costs nothing honest.
quantities.downstream_rule: When Z(b) = 0, every quantity whose carrier depends on a compatible whole state is ABSENT, not zero. A receipt reporting Z = 0 alongside a numeric S_vn or I(A:B) on the same section set is CONTRADICTED, not merely undischarged.
structure_signals: an integer count keyed against a declared boundary condition
quantities.repo_instance: No DECLARED instance found in system_v8.
quantities.table_addition: Not a row in the 9-row chart table. Taken from the diagram body at C6, kept because it carries the TYPED RELEASE rule.

all_of._why: H(p) <= log2 |support|. A Shannon entropy above the address capacity of its own alphabet is contradicted.
a record by reference is only a carrier if the reference resolves and the numbers are compared. Otherwise it is `a procedure is named`, which the estate has already recorded as not a discharge.

quantities.absent_disposition_why: Satisfiable by EITHER branch, so a producer that actually computed H(p) can always satisfy one: it held p. Neither branch present means a Shannon entropy is being reported at a stratum whose licensing layer the receipt has not reached, which is the specific error this chart exists to prevent and which this repo already has a dedicated negative sim for (system_v8/negative_sims/results/shannon_early/receipt.json, disposition FAILED_AS_EXPECTED). An equally honest implementation would PARK this -- recorded as ambiguity AM-02.
structure_signals: a value in [0, log2 k] adjacent to a k-element normalized numeric array
quantities.repo_instance: system_v8/axis0_shell/results/axis0_shell_run/axis0_shell_receipt.json variants.shift__peps3d_block.measures.path_entropy = 3.0. Binds SUSPECTED only; no probability map or record is declared, so it PARKs. 3.0 is also exactly log2(8), so it is indistinguishable by value from an address capacity -- see separation SEP-1.

all_of._why: rank is an integer. This is the finiteness signature that distinguishes S_0 from a smooth entropy.

THE SHARPEST CLAUSE IN THIS TABLE. The rank of a float64 density matrix is not well defined without a singular-value cutoff. A cutoff accepted from the receipt at verification time IS the s3/s6 defeat -- a measured-scale number in a slot the gate trusts. So the cutoff must resolve to a contract fixed BEFORE the run by hash, and a receipt-supplied cutoff is refused outright.
separation SEP-3c. rank <= dim, checked against the density carrier's OWN declared dimension and never against an address capacity.
separation SEP-2 and SEP-3. A density rank is not a support count and not an address count.

quantities.absent_disposition_why: Every field this predicate demands is already in the hands of anything that computed a rank: it diagonalized or decomposed the matrix. The rank-cutoff clause makes BLOCK the only coherent choice -- a receipt that supplies its own cutoff has built the relieving surface itself, and PARKing that would leave the exact defect this table was written after.
structure_signals: value equals log2 of a declared integer rank on a declared density carrier
quantities.repo_instance: No DECLARED instance found in system_v8. system_v8/manifold/results/base_mss.json ...model.rank = 4 is a matroid rank, a different object with a different carrier.

quantities.formula: S(rho) = - Tr(rho log2 rho)   (the alpha -> 1 limit, not the Renyi formula)

all_of._why: S(rho) >= 0 for any PSD unit-trace rho. A negative value past the floor is excluded BY THE CARRIER the receipt itself declared. This is the whole semantic move: the check does not ask what the field is called, it asks what the declared structure permits.
S_0 >= S_1 for a fixed state. Vacuous when S_0 is absent, and the vacuity is reported rather than silently passing.

quantities.absent_disposition_why: This is the most-reported entropy in the repo and the one with a live contradicted instance, so the obligation has to bite where the numbers actually are. The carrier fields are cheap for any honest producer -- a von Neumann entropy is computed FROM the spectrum. Legacy receipts that hold PSD and trace evidence adjacently but declare no carrier_ref bind SUSPECTED and land in PARK, not BLOCK, so the strictness does not retroactively condemn the estate.
structure_signals: value adjacent to a declared purity and a trace deviation on the same object
quantities.repo_instance: system_v8/unified/results/manifold_unified_v2/receipt.json layer_computations.L09.shuffled_correlations.von_neumann_entropy_bits = -0.026676102030894332. NEGATIVE, 1e10 past entropy_nonneg_floor. Under DECLARED binding this is CONTRADICTED -> BLOCK. Under SUSPECTED binding (which is what actually applies today, since no carrier_ref exists) it PARKs. Both readings are live and the table reports which one it used.

all_of._why: an unstated alpha leaves the formula unidentified. Purity, collision entropy and min-entropy are all `S_alpha` under different alpha, and they are not interchangeable.

S_0 >= S_1 >= S_2 >= S_inf for a FIXED state. The owner note is explicit that this ordering makes support/rank a plausible EARLY COORDINATE and does NOT make the quantities into one serial sequence. So the ordering is checked WITHIN the density branch only, never across carrier classes.

quantities.absent_disposition_why: Same carrier as S_vn plus one declared number. The alpha clause is the added reason for BLOCK: without alpha there is no formula, so there is nothing for an auditor to later discharge.
structure_signals: value reported alongside a declared alpha on a density carrier
quantities.repo_instance: system_v8/unified/results/manifold_unified_v2/receipt.json layer_computations.L09.shuffled_correlations.purity = 0.022015216521145867. Purity is Tr(rho^2), an unlogged alpha=2 quantity. Binds SUSPECTED at best; PARKs. Under DECLARED binding it would need alpha and would fail value_range unless declared as the trace rather than the entropy -- an ambiguity recorded as AM-05.

all_of._why: without a stated bipartition you cannot say between WHAT. The number names nothing.
I(A:B) >= 0 by subadditivity on any PSD unit-trace joint state. Negative past the floor is excluded by the declared carrier.
a cut is a decomposition of a TENSOR carrier. A pair index J x J is not a tensor cut; conflating them would let a pair-support count be reported as a correlation.

quantities.absent_disposition_why: A mutual information with no declared cut is the clearest case of a coordinate present without its carrier: the formula has three terms and the receipt has not said which subsystems they are over. Nothing an auditor adds later recovers the producer's intended bipartition.
structure_signals: value reported beside two declared part dimensions whose product is the carrier dimension
quantities.repo_instance: system_v8/unified/results/manifold_unified_v2/receipt.json layer_computations.L08.flattened_terminal_cuts.mutual_information_bits = -2.1471713296250527e-13. Negative but INSIDE mutual_information_nonneg_floor, so value_range holds. The key named `flattened_terminal_cuts` is a hint of a cut, not a declaration, so this binds SUSPECTED and PARKs on the missing declaration -- not on its value.

quantities.formula: D(rho || sigma) = Tr[ rho (log2 rho - log2 sigma) ]
quantities.first_meaningful_at: density branch only, TWO compatible density states

all_of._why: D >= 0 by Klein's inequality.
if supp(rho) is not contained in supp(sigma) then D = +infinity. A FINITE reported D alongside a violated support inclusion is contradicted, and a reported +inf is a TYPED RELEASE case, not a number.

quantities.absent_disposition_why: A divergence needs two states. One state cannot support it, and a receipt naming only one has not reported D at all. The support-inclusion assertion is the load-bearing part: without it, an infinite divergence and a small one are indistinguishable in the receipt.
structure_signals: value reported beside two distinct declared density carriers
quantities.repo_instance: system_v8/nested_manifold/results/rungB/receipt.json line 74 carries "G3_forward_D_rho_rhostar": Infinity -- a BARE non-finite JSON literal at a relative-entropy position. This is the TYPED RELEASE case appearing in the wild: the honest answer is a support-violation DESCRIPTOR (supp(rho) not contained in supp(rho*)), and instead a number-shaped token that no arithmetic can consume was written. ATTRIBUTION MATTERS: the BLOCK on this file was measured at exit 1 from the REUSED strict_parse, not from this table's D_rel predicate -- the document never reaches predicate evaluation. Credit the reused parser, not the carrier obligation.

quantities.formula: sigma(rho) = entropy production rate under a stated process, evaluated at or against a stationary state

all_of._why: `a stationary state is named` is not `a stationary state was found`. The residual ||L[rho_ss]|| is the checkable difference.

quantities.absent_disposition_why: THE ONE PARK IN THIS TABLE, and the reason is not leniency. Finding the stationary state of a declared generator is a SEPARATE fixed-point solve that the run reporting the rate may legitimately not have performed, so `carrier absent` here has an honest reading that no other row in this table has. A rate reported against a transient state is a real quantity about a real process whose stationarity is genuinely open, and BLOCKing it would exclude honest open-process work -- the F11 error in claimgate_plugin/results/purgatory_engine_witness_v0.json. PARK costs the producer everything they wanted anyway: PARK is not admission, so no citation, no promotion, no count as a result. If a consumer maps PARK to gate_admits=1, this row becomes the table's soft spot and the fault is the consumer's.
structure_signals: a rate reported beside a declared GKSL or Liouvillian generator
quantities.repo_instance: system_v8/unified/results/manifold_unified_v2/receipt.json layer_computations.L11.stages[].entropy_injection_bits = -0.013274422367730798, and layer_computations.L07...axis1_dissipative_entropy_delta_bits = 0.013286479347021096. Signed values are FINE here -- an entropy DELTA or injection may be negative, unlike S_vn. Which is exactly why the sign check is attached per quantity to its carrier and not applied to `numbers that look like entropies`.

capacity_separations._why: The owner rule THE THREE CAPACITIES MUST NEVER COLLAPSE INTO ONE NUMBER, made checkable. A receipt that reports one capacity under another name is a CONFLATION. Each separation gets its own predicate, and each predicate is a NON-IDENTITY -- it fires on an asserted or structural equation between quantities whose carriers are of different classes.

_the_general_form.name: one_number_two_carrier_classes
_the_general_form.statement: The same value position may not be bound to two quantity ids whose required_carrier classes differ, and two quantity ids with different carrier classes may not share one carrier_ref, unless an explicit map between the two carriers is declared.
_the_general_form.why_semantic_not_syntactic: This does not look at names, paths, types or bounds. It looks at whether two declared quantities are resting on ONE declared structure that cannot support both. A producer cannot relabel around it, because renaming a quantity changes which carrier the table demands, and the demand is what collides.

separations.name: address_capacity_is_not_pair_support
separations.non_identity: log2 |J| (n bits)  !=  log2 |J x J| (2n bits)
separations.owner_statement_quoted: 2^n addresses is NOT 4^n ordered pairs (j,k). This distinction is load-bearing.

checks.why: H0_pair > 2 * H0_addr asserts a support larger than the space that indexes it. Structural, not a tolerance.

H0_pair == H0_addr is ADMISSIBLE -- a field supported on 2^n of the 4^n pairs, for instance a diagonal. It is admissible only WITH an explicit support_restriction declaration stating |supp F| = |J| and how. Absent that declaration, equal values under two capacity names is the conflation itself. The fix is one field, so the receipt is decided rather than pending. Contested: see ambiguity AM-03.
an address set and a pair-indexed field are different declarations. One carrier_ref serving both means the receipt has only one structure and is naming it twice.

separations.name: pair_support_is_not_density_rank
separations.non_identity: log2 |supp F|  !=  S_0(rho) = log2 rank rho
separations.owner_statement_quoted: The 'jk fuzz' is formalized as a finite pair-supported fibre -- NOT a diagonal probability distribution, NOT a density matrix.

checks.why: a pair_indexed_field carrier and a density_operator carrier are different classes. If they are the same declaration, a finite relation is being read as a state.

a declared derived_from pointing S_0 at a support count computes log2 of a cardinality and calls it a rank. Both are `log2 of an integer`, so value-level checks CANNOT separate them -- only the declared derivation can. This is the sharpest reason the table asks what a quantity REQUIRES rather than what it looks like.

equal values are NOT evidence of conflation -- rank and support size coincide legitimately all the time. Recorded as a report so nobody later promotes a coincidence into a finding. Deliberately not a disposition.

separations.name: address_capacity_is_not_density_rank
separations.non_identity: log2 |J| = n  !=  S_0(rho) = log2 rank rho
separations.owner_statement_quoted: S0(rho) = log2 rank rho -- a LATER carrier-specific quantity. No probability, no metric, no density matrix at this stratum [R0].

checks._defect_found_by_measuring: An earlier encoding used a flat `subjects` list and the evaluator checked ALL PAIRS within it, so S_vn and S_alpha sharing one rho -- which is entirely legitimate, they are the same carrier class -- was reported VIOLATED on fixture c16. A separation is directional: ONE subject against others of a DIFFERENT class. Corrected to subject/others.
checks.why: R0 carries ADDRESS CAPACITY ONLY. A density quantity resting on an R0 carrier has imported a state into a stratum the owner diagram says has none.

S_0 == H0_addr says rank rho = |J|. That is only meaningful with a declared embedding J -> basis(H). Without the map, dim(H) is not |J| and the equation is a coincidence being asserted as an identity.
rank <= dim. Uses the density carrier's OWN declared dimension, not an address capacity -- which is the separation restated as a bound.

no_scalar_total.statement: No field may be declared as an aggregate whose components span more than one carrier class. The chart is a TYPED FAMILY, not a vertical ladder.
no_scalar_total.owner_statement_quoted: That ordering does NOT make Shannon, cut entropy and von Neumann entropy into one serial sequence or one scalar total.
no_scalar_total.note: The safe transverse receipt A = { dH0_pair, dkappa, dS_alpha, dI, dsigma } is a FAMILY with coordinates ABSENT when their carrier is absent. Absent means the key is not present. A zero is not an absence, and a receipt that writes 0.0 for a coordinate whose carrier is undeclared has replaced a typed absence with a number.
no_scalar_total.absence_encoding_rule: ABSENT = key not present. Writing null, 0, 0.0, NaN, or the string 'N/A' for an absent coordinate is a declared-type violation, not an absence.

secondary_separations._why: From the owner block SEPARATIONS THAT MUST STAY EXPLICIT. Not entropy-chart rows, and not the three capacity separations asked for, but they are non-identities of the same form and cheap to carry here rather than lose.

items.non_identity: [A,B] != 0 is NONCOMMUTATION; [a,b,c]_star != 0 is NONASSOCIATIVITY (associator). One does not establish the other.
normalized spinor != global Weyl-spinor field (the latter needs a spin lift, w2(TM) = 0).
chi(S^2) = 2 != chi(T^2) = 0. A torus cannot silently equal a sphere.
Hopf torus leaves T_eta are DISJOINT, not nested. Regions V_eta CAN nest.

secondary_separations.status: PREDICATE SKETCHES. The four ops named here (forbid_evidence_substitution, forbid_relation, value_from_declared_topology, distinct_carrier_refs on named non-chart objects) are NOT implemented in the reference evaluator. Carried as spec, and the evaluator refuses to score this block rather than pretending to.

ratchet_role._why: Owner rule: THE RATCHET IS NOT A ROW IN THIS STACK. Stating this table's formal role so it is never read as a rung.
ratchet_role.this_table_is: a constraint packet -- preconditions on admissible candidates
this_table_is_not: a Ratchet comparison of complete compatible towers
ratchet_role.cycle_note: A cycle has NO privileged ontological first stage. With invertible maps a rotation is CONJUGATE (Phi_0 . Phi_cycle . Phi_0^-1); with DISSIPATIVE maps rotating the protocol can be genuinely different and must be TESTED. This table therefore carries no ordering obligation on engine stages, and any check that assumed one would be out of scope.

residual_evasions._why: Named here rather than discovered by a stress lane later. An unnamed residual is how a candidate becomes the fifth failure.

items.evasion: DO NOT NAME THE QUANTITY. Declare nothing, and name the key `v17` so no name_signal matches. The table's obligation never fires.
items.what_it_costs_the_producer: the number is uncitable AS that quantity. Any downstream use has to re-attach the name, and at that point the obligation fires on the citing document.
items.why_this_is_not_closure: an unwitnessed number still sits in a committed file, and a human reader may cite it anyway. This table converts a hiding place into an anonymity requirement. It does not remove the number.
items.what_would_close_it: a completeness obligation on the receipt itself -- every numeric leaf must be bound to a declared quantity id or to a declared non-claim role, with the count of unbound leaves committed and failing when it grows. That is a DIFFERENT design and it has its own failure mode: `declared non-claim role` is a relieving surface by another name. Not attempted here.

items.evasion: DECLARE THE CARRIER FALSELY. Write psd: true, trace: 1.0, rank: 4, dimension: 8, and a fabricated S_vn consistent with all of it.
items.why_this_table_cannot_catch_it: every check is on the receipt's internal consistency. A consistent fabrication is consistent.
items.what_would_close_it: artifact binding and output-dependence, per claimgate_plugin/results/purgatory_engine_witness_v0.json what_would_have_to_be_true_instead. The artifact_binding op is DEFINED in this table's op vocabulary and used only by H_shannon's record branch; it is NOT the table's general mechanism. Different lane.

items.evasion: AIM AT THE ONE PARK. Report everything as sigma_prod, whose absent_disposition is PARK.
items.why_it_buys_little: PARK is not admission. A receipt whose every quantity PARKs is a receipt with no admitted quantities.
items.why_it_is_still_recorded: it is only worthless IF the consumer maps PARK to gate_admits=0. The estate has already shipped a consumer that did the opposite. The evasion is therefore live against the CHAIN even though it is dead against this table.

items.evasion: EXPLOIT A VACUOUS CROSS-CHECK. cross_quantity_le is vacuous when the other quantity is absent, so omit S_0 and S_vn's ordering check never fires.
items.mitigation_in_table: vacuity is REPORTED per check, not silently passed, so a receipt can be measured on how many of its cross-checks were vacuous.
items.why_it_is_still_open: reporting vacuity is not refusing it. Nothing in this table forces S_0 to be present alongside S_vn.

items.evasion: SUPPLY THE RANK CUTOFF UNDER ANOTHER NAME. preregistered_contract forbids a receipt-supplied rank_cutoff by that field name; call it `svd_eps` instead.
items.status: OPEN. This is the four-times error class reappearing INSIDE this table -- a field NAME standing in for a judgement. The only structural fix is that the contract is fetched by hash from a preregistered file and the receipt is never consulted for any threshold, which makes the check `no threshold is read from the receipt at all` rather than `this named threshold is not read`. Stated, not implemented.

items.evasion: GROW THE TABLE. Add a quantity whose carrier_predicate is empty, and route numbers to it.
items.mitigation_in_table: the reference evaluator refuses a table whose quantity has an empty predicate, an unknown op, or an absent_disposition outside {BLOCK, PARK}, and it fails CLOSED on such a table rather than grading receipts against it. Measured in this session.

ambiguities._why: Every place two honest implementations could read the owner chart differently. Ambiguity found now is cheap. Each entry names what would SEPARATE the readings, so none of these is a permanent shrug.

readings: R0's address set is BINARY BY DEFINITION (J_n = {0,1}^n), so H0_addr is always the integer n and log2|S| over a non-binary finite S is a DIFFERENT quantity needing its own row
R0's carrier line says `a finite address set` generally, so H0_addr is log2 of any finite cardinality and integrality is conditional on a declared binary alphabet
items.chosen_here: the second, encoded as a conditional value_is_integer gated on alphabet == binary
items.live_repo_stake: system_v8/engine_native/results/torch_graph/receipt.json hartley_capacity_bits = log2(12). Under reading one it is not H0_addr at all; under reading two it is H0_addr over a 12-element set.
items.what_would_separate_them: an owner ruling on whether {0,1}^n at R0 is a definition or the leading example.

readings: the chart is a LICENSING ORDER: H(p) before D4/record is a layer violation, so carrier-absent is BLOCK
the chart is a DOCUMENTATION REQUIREMENT: a Shannon entropy over a finite empirical distribution is routine, so carrier-absent is PARK
items.chosen_here: BLOCK, because premature Shannon is the specific error the chart exists to prevent and the repo already carries a dedicated negative sim for it
items.what_would_separate_them: whether the owner intends `first meaningful at` as a gate on admission or as a note about interpretation.

readings: equal capacities with no support_restriction is the conflation itself, and the fix is one field, so BLOCK
a diagonal-supported pair field legitimately has |supp F| = |J| and the producer may simply not have declared it, so PARK
items.cost_if_wrong: a false BLOCK on an honest diagonal field, which is the F11 route-around risk
items.what_would_separate_them: whether this table is a forward producer contract or a scanner over existing receipts. It cannot be both at this strictness.

readings: RECORD and PROBABILITY MAP are ALTERNATIVES — either licenses H(p) (encoded here as any_of_groups)
the RECORD is the licensing carrier and a probability map is merely how p is presented, so a bare p never licenses H(p) and D4 must actually be reached
items.consequence_of_the_other_reading: H_shannon's probability-map branch disappears and every Shannon entropy in the estate needs a record reference
items.what_would_separate_them: an owner ruling on what D4/record adds beyond p existing.

readings: purity Tr(rho^2) is S_alpha at alpha=2 before the log, so it is the same row and must be logged before the chart applies
purity is its own quantity with its own carrier obligation and is not an entropy at all
items.chosen_here: left unresolved. S_alpha's predicate demands a declared alpha, which a purity field will fail, so purity currently PARKs as SUSPECTED rather than being forced into either reading.
items.what_would_separate_them: whether the chart's rows are FORMULAS (purity is not one of them) or FAMILIES (purity is inside the Renyi family).

readings: the R3 fibration kappa(c) = log2|R_c| and the C3 extension kappa_Pi(u) = log2|Fib_Pi(u)| are ONE construction seen at two strata, so one row with a carrier parameter
they are two constructions over different carriers (a cell of a cubical complex vs an equivalence class under a probe family), so two rows
items.chosen_here: two rows, because the required carriers differ and the probe-family obligation attaches only to kappa_ext
items.consequence: the 9-row chart table becomes 12 rows here; the three additions are flagged with table_addition on each quantity
items.what_would_separate_them: whether pi : E -> K and q_Pi : E_C -> Q_Pi are meant as instances of one quotient pattern.

readings: S_vn is S_alpha at alpha=1 and needs no separate row; a receipt reporting a von Neumann entropy should declare alpha=1
S_vn is its own row because the Renyi formula is singular at alpha=1 and the repo reports von_neumann_entropy_bits directly
items.what_would_separate_them: an owner ruling. The chart lists S_alpha and S_0 and is silent on S_1.

items.rule: coordinates ABSENT when their required carrier is absent
readings: ABSENT means the KEY IS NOT PRESENT IN THE RECEIPT — writing null, 0, 0.0, NaN or 'N/A' is a declared-type violation
ABSENT refers to the transverse readout A only: A omits the coordinate, while the receipt may still carry the raw number elsewhere
items.what_would_separate_them: whether A = { dH0_pair, dkappa, dS_alpha, dI, dsigma } is a VIEW over a receipt or IS the receipt.

readings: floors are ABSOLUTE table-fixed constants — the only form that cannot be influenced by a receipt
floors must scale with declared dimension or condition number, because a 4096-dimensional accumulation exceeds 1e-12 honestly
items.cost_of_the_choice: false BLOCKs on large honest systems
items.cost_of_the_alternative: the floor becomes a function of a receipt-supplied dimension, which is a weaker form of the s3/s6 relieving slot
items.what_would_separate_them: measuring the largest honest round-off in the estate at each dimension. Not done.

readings: SUSPECTED is capped at PARK permanently, because name recognition can never carry a BLOCK
SUSPECTED escalates to BLOCK after a declared migration point, which is the only thing that makes residual RE-1 (do not name the quantity) actually cost the producer
items.what_would_separate_them: an owner decision about migration, not a measurement.

readings: a CLASSICAL mutual information over a joint p(a,b) is in the H_shannon family and needs a joint probability map, not a tensor cut
it is I_AB with a degenerate cut, and `cut` means any bipartition of an index set rather than a tensor factorization
items.chosen_here: left unresolved. cut_declared demands part_dimensions multiplying to the carrier dimension, which a classical joint distribution can satisfy, so the table does not currently force either reading.
items.what_would_separate_them: whether the chart's `TENSOR/CUT decomposition` is one requirement or two alternatives.

readings: a density carrier must always declare a spectrum, so psd and trace are always VERIFIED and never asserted
psd:true is acceptable when no spectrum is declared, reported as a producer assertion
items.chosen_here: the second, after defect D5 made the inconsistency explicit
items.consequence_of_the_stricter_reading: most existing repo receipts would BLOCK rather than PARK
items.what_would_separate_them: whether this table is a forward contract or a scanner — the same fork as AM-03, which suggests they should be decided together.

readings: exit 0 means the structural obligation is met and nothing more; whether an engine computed the number is a different lane's question
exit 0 should be unreachable until output-dependence is also checked, so this table's best outcome ought to be PARK
items.chosen_here: the first, but only because artifact_binding now performs a real digest-and-value comparison. Before defect D4 was fixed, the second reading was plainly correct.
items.what_would_separate_them: whether a value matching a committed artifact counts as evidence the value was computed, or only that it was recorded consistently. The second is the stronger position and it is not refuted here.

defects_found_by_measuring_this_table._why: Found by running the reference evaluator against the fixtures, not by reading the table. Recorded because a candidate whose own defects are only listed by its author has not been measured, and because one of these was a fail-open in the evaluator itself.

items.defect: Outcomes were combined with max() over EXIT CODES, and the exit codes are not ordered by severity: PARK is 3 and BLOCK is 1, so max() picked PARK. A separation whose on_violation is BLOCK was reported at exit 3, which downstream reads as pending rather than decided. Fixtures c3, c14, c15 and c16 all measured PARK while carrying BLOCK findings.
items.fix: an explicit SEVERITY map with a worse() combinator; exit codes are derived from severity and never compared.
items.lesson: The estate's own exit-code convention is not severity-ordered. Any new component that combines dispositions by comparing exit codes inherits this fail-open.

items.defect: SEP-3a used a flat subjects list and the evaluator checked ALL PAIRS within it, so S_vn and S_alpha resting on one rho was reported VIOLATED. Two quantities of the SAME carrier class sharing one carrier is correct practice.
items.fix: separations are directional: one subject against others of a differing class.
items.lesson: A separation is a non-identity between CLASSES, not a uniqueness constraint over a set of names.

items.defect: Discharge was credited whenever ANY clause anywhere in a predicate was artifact_binding, including a group that was never taken. H_shannon satisfying its probability-map branch was recorded PRESENT_DISCHARGED on the strength of the record branch's artifact clause.
items.fix: discharge follows the any_of group that actually held.
items.lesson: Flattening a predicate for validation is fine; flattening it for scoring erases which branch was taken.

items.defect: artifact_binding accepted the producer's own boolean values_compared:true as the discharge. That is precisely the class recorded in claimgate_plugin/results/controller_literal_verdicts_v0.json — a literal field the producer wrote standing in for work.
items.fix: the evaluator now recomputes the artifact sha256, strict-parses the artifact, reads a declared value_path and compares that value to the claimed one itself. Measured: c12 exit 0 with matching values, c20 exit 1 on a claim/artifact mismatch, c21 exit 1 on a digest mismatch, c22 exit 1 on the old producer-boolean form.
items.lesson: The whole reason this estate distrusts receipts applies to this table's own discharge mechanism.

items.found_by: reading the table after fixing D4
items.defect: carrier_assert_true accepted psd:true as a producer boolean, in the same table that had just refused a producer boolean for artifact discharge.
items.fix: where the carrier declares a spectrum, psd is VERIFIED from it against psd_eigenvalue_floor. Measured: fixture c23 exit 1, `carrier asserts psd true, but its OWN declared spectrum has minimum eigenvalue -0.05`. With no spectrum the clause holds and is labelled PRODUCER ASSERTION.
items.residual: a carrier that declares no spectrum still rests on a boolean. The stricter reading — require a spectrum for every density carrier — would refuse most existing repo receipts, so it is recorded as ambiguity rather than imposed.

items.found_by: reading the measured output for fixtures c19 through c22
items.defect: When every branch of an any_of_groups predicate failed, the failure list was an unlabelled concatenation, so the reason surfaced was whichever group came first. Four artifact-binding defects were reported as `carrier class is 'record', quantity requires 'probability_map'` — the correct disposition attached to the wrong cause.
items.fix: failures carry their group, and the group with the FEWEST failures (the one the producer was evidently aiming at) is reported first. Re-measured: c19 now attributes to artifact path resolving outside the committed tree, c20 to the claim not matching the artifact, c21 to a digest mismatch, c22 to the missing value_path.
items.lesson: A right disposition with a wrong reason gets fixed in the wrong place. Attribution is part of the finding, not decoration on it.

measurement.status_ladder_position: runs. Not `passes local rerun` for anything beyond the fixtures, and not `canonical by process`.
measurement.what_was_measured: table integrity exit 4 (TABLE_ACCEPTED_NO_INPUT, 12 quantities, both op vocabularies fully implemented); fail-closed control exit 2 on a table with an injected unimplemented op; 23 fixtures, 23 agreeing with their preregistered dispositions, 0 mismatches; 310 real system_v8 JSON files measured, 307 PARK and 3 BLOCK.
measurement.what_the_corpus_number_does_and_does_not: 307 PARK is NOT a pass and NOT a finding about those receipts' correctness. It is the measured consequence of the binding rule: not one file in system_v8 carries a typed_ontology declaration block, so every one of them asserts no quantity under this table and is UNCITABLE through it. 54 of them carry at least one SUSPECTED quantity by name signal, the largest being 9528 numeric leaves matching a signal in system_v8/manifold/results/deep/whole_manifold_v2.json. The 3 BLOCKs are attributable to the REUSED strict_parse, not to any carrier obligation: two are deliberate hostile fixtures (harness_patch dupkey and nan) and the third is system_v8/nested_manifold/results/rungB/receipt.json carrying a bare Infinity literal at a relative-entropy position.

No cross-lane agreement is claimed and none would be evidence if it were -- per claimgate_plugin/results/purgatory_shape_detectors_v0.json, cross-lane agreement is independent proposal fuel.
